problem_class.label: other
problem_class.details: Constrained monotone variational inequality: find x* ∈ X with ⟨F(x*),w−x*⟩ ≥ 0 for every w ∈ X. X is convex, F is continuous and globally monotone; no objective function or saddle representation is assumed. A solution satisfies ‖x0−x*‖ ≤ R and ‖F(x*)‖ ≤ G.

oracle.label: proximal
oracle.details: Separately counted exact Euclidean projection onto X, characterized by proj(z) ∈ X and ⟨z−proj(z),w−proj(z)⟩ ≤ 0 for every w ∈ X.

oracle.label: other
oracle.details: Unbiased stochastic operator evaluations g(x,ω), valid on X, with independent identically distributed seeds. The oracle supplies operator values, not necessarily gradients.

distinctive_assumptions.label: generalized_smoothness
distinctive_assumptions.details: For all x,y,M, a bound ‖F(x+θ(y−x))‖ ≤ M along the entire segment implies ‖F(x)−F(y)‖ ≤ (L0+L1 M)‖x−y‖. L0 > 0 and L1 ≥ 0.

distinctive_assumptions.label: finite_dimensional
distinctive_assumptions.details: Finite-dimensional complete real inner-product space with its Borel measurable structure; no dimension-dependent restriction or bounded diameter of X is assumed.

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: Gap-dependent second moment: E‖g(x,ω)−F(x)‖² ≤ σ²+v⟨F(x)−F(x*),x−x*⟩ on X, with σ,v ≥ 0. No uniform variance bound or exponential-tail assumption is imposed. All parameters, including x0,L0,L1,R,G,σ,v,ε,δ, are public; F,X,x*,g and their probability law are hidden.

accuracy.label: feasibility
accuracy.details: The successful output must belong to X jointly with satisfying the residual criterion.

accuracy.label: high_probability
accuracy.details: Joint feasibility and residual accuracy hold with probability at least 1−δ, for ε > 0 and 0 < δ < 1, under the combined algorithm and oracle randomness. Both oracle budgets are fixed caps.

accuracy.label: other
accuracy.details: A measurable output x must admit ξ ∈ N_X(x) with ‖F(x)+ξ‖ ≤ ε. This is an unsquared normal-cone residual criterion, not a variational gap or an unconstrained operator norm criterion.

setup_category.label: non_standard
setup_category.reason: The constrained monotone VI combines operator-norm-dependent generalized smoothness, gap-dependent stochastic variance, and a high-probability normal-cone residual requirement under separately counted projection and sampling budgets.
